messages.message:
According to the fictional Northaven Instruments returns policy, breaking the calibration seal means a GBP45 recalibration fee applies if you return the instrument. You would also pay return postage unless the item is faulty or sent in error. If you want to start a return, you would email returns@northaven-instruments.example with your reference and reason.

Is there anything else I can help with about your order or the return process?
